name: wipebot
description: A World of Warcraft raid assistant for any guild: why a pull wiped, how a night went, how a player did, how a boss works, with the method for reading a log.

interface.shortDescription: A World of Warcraft raid assistant for any guild.
interface.longDescription: Ask why a pull wiped, how a raid night went, what keeps wiping the raid, or how a player did and why their damage or healing is low. The Wipebot connector reads the reports from Warcraft Logs and computes every number in code; the raid-log-analysis skill says how to read them. Sign in with your Warcraft Logs account.
defaultPrompt: Why did we wipe on the last pull?
How did I do on this boss tonight?
